rules.wet: (sea OR pond) AND NoFakeWave surface > ground + 0.01
rules.dry: NOT sea AND NOT pond AND NoFakeWave surface <= ground + 0.01
rules.concrete_test: Unchanged strict depth test; known unresolved failure remains explicit
rules.other: No changes to framing, coordinates, streaming, reference height, bridge, dam, or source/package hashes

limits: NoFakeWave still includes real sea waves. This changes acceptance from instantaneous fake-wave depth to engine coverage and no-fake level; requires explicit user decision. Temporal sample is not a bound for all weather.
